title: Shipping Fees, Cold-Chain and Delivery Reporting Terms — Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program
content:
Expedited (two-day) shipping requested by the customer costs 24.50 on every tier of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program and is never billed to a payer. The fulfilment terms below set that fee and the other shipping and delivery figures for each tier.

## Fees

| Tier | Standard shipping fee (USD) | Free-shipping threshold (USD) | Expedited shipping fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 6.95 | 75.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 |

The standard shipping fee is the fee for standard ground shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold. The free-shipping threshold is the shipment cash-price total, in USD, at or above which standard shipping is free; a threshold of 0.00 means standard shipping is always free.

Hypothetical self-pay shipments: a shipment whose cash-price total is 74.99 is below the 75.00 threshold and carries the 6.95 standard shipping fee; a shipment whose cash-price total is exactly 75.00 reaches the threshold and ships free.

## Delivery and reporting figures (identical on all seven tiers)

| Figure | Value on every tier | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| Carrier trace period | 3 business days | Business days (Monday-Friday excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit |
| Courtesy reships | 1 per program per rolling 12 months | No-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date |
| Damage report window | 2 calendar days | Window for reporting a package damaged in transit or delivered warm, counted from the carrier delivery date |
| Defect report window | 7 calendar days | Window for reporting a pen or vial that was defective as shipped (cracked, wrong product or strength, expired, recalled lot), counted from the carrier delivery date |
| Signature on delivery | Not required | Whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of an insulin package |
| Cold-chain validation | 48 hours | Hours the insulated shipper keeps insulin at 2-8 C; a package delivered later than this after its ship time is treated as a temperature excursion |
| Shipment consolidation | 7 calendar days | Refills of a customer's Part B pump insulin program and Part D or MA-PD program whose earliest ship dates fall within this many calendar days of each other ship together in one insulated shipper on the later date |

The tier names the delivery figures apply to are the Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program, Commercial HMO Program, Commercial PPO Program, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program, Medicare Part D Program, Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program and Medicaid Program.
